acceptance_predicates.description: Configured online provider execution is the default for canonical run, sweep, easy, recording/campaign, and TUI handoff paths.
Local mock is available only through an explicit option and is labeled as non-live evidence.
Offline replay remains explicit, network-denied, and cannot silently substitute for a live or mock run.
Missing credentials, provider failures, unsupported selections, and authority failures are typed actionable errors with no silent fallback.
Provider, model, agent, workload, mode, and credential-reference identity remain bound and privacy-safe.

definition_of_done: Canonical and easy run/sweep paths pass default-online and explicit-mock positive/negative tests.
Recording/campaign and TUI handoff contracts preserve the same mode semantics without making the frontend authoritative.
Focused/full gates, independent review, exact-head CI, post-merge verification, and documentation evidence pass.

inputs.description: Persisted provider/model/agent selection and credential reference digest.
Canonical CLI, easy workflow, recording/campaign, and TUI handoff commands.

outputs.description: Consistent default-online command behavior with explicit mock and replay alternatives.

gates.description: All scoped entry points implement and test default-online, explicit-mock, explicit-replay, and no-fallback behavior.
Credentials remain references/digests only and mode/provider identity is bounded.
Exact reviewed PR and protected-main post-merge workflows pass.
